# Saved sweep-history fixture

`flanged-elbow.FCStd` is an original synthetic model generated with the typed
`flanged()` control in `tools/freecad_sweep_cases.py` and FreeCAD 1.1.4.
It contains additive/subtractive circular sweeps, centroid-attached flanges and
native holes. No third-party model or implementation was imported.

This fixture exercises the closed saved-source admission vocabulary and the
source-to-copy property contract without importing native FreeCAD on the host.
Native copying, regeneration and edits require the separate native qualifier.
The fixture is historical input, not evidence that current source is qualified.
